answer: Beacon audits with compute heartbeats stop fake identities. Each agent posts a $25 deposit locked 10 epochs. At dawn, a beacon issues a random challenge; each identity must answer with compute proof, and a second miss burns its deposit. Rented reputation is slashed with its lender. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 1,000 jobs, exceeding fake gains. Trust grows like a glacier. An honest agent pays $25 once and earns undiluted rewards.
